expected_behavior: Domain verification must classify the unprojected verifier envelope. Only after check_domain derives the top-level domain verdict should run_domain_check replace the nested kernel with the public project_kernel representation; projection must not turn a successful kernel verdict into "violated" or erase formal_result.
test_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_01.rs b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_01.rs
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_01.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let source = include_str!("../src/main.rs");
+    let function = source
+        .split_once("fn run_domain_check(")
+        .expect("run_domain_check")
+        .1
+        .split_once("\nfn run_domain_analyze(")
+        .expect("run_domain_check boundary")
+        .0;
+
+    let classify = function
+        .find("fsl_tools::check_domain(&domain, &kernel)")
+        .expect("classify the unprojected kernel");
+    let project = function
+        .find("fslc_rust::outcome::project_kernel(kernel)")
+        .expect("publish the projected kernel");
+    assert!(
+        classify < project,
+        "the domain verdict must be classified before kernel projection"
+    );
+    assert!(function.contains(
+        "*kernel_output = fslc_rust::outcome::project_kernel(kernel);"
+    ));
+}
